stats.notes: Baseline from IPEDS (fall 2023 entering class, ADM2023); Longwood's Common Data Set page lists files only through 2019-2020, so no recent CDS was read. College Navigator also shows fall 2024: 5,391 applicants, 90% admitted (exact admit count not given), SAT EBRW 530/580/630 and Math 500/540/580 for 205 submitters (25%). Longwood's admission-requirements page prints 'accepted students at a glance' (undated): mid-range GPA 3.35-4.02, SAT 1040-1230, ACT 21-27. ACT percentiles are not listed because only 23 enrolled students (3%) submitted ACT in fall 2023. International applicant and admit counts, GPA distribution and SAT total are not available from IPEDS.

cds_test_policy.notes: Longwood's admission-requirements page: test-optional for fall 2027 for all majors except nursing, which requires scores.
